 "content": """"Anonymize personal names across the workspace and session transcript.

Names are derived from /workspace/case.md (order of first appearance) so that
no personal name has to be written into this script or any shell command.
"""
import re
import pathlib

CASE = pathlib.Path("/workspace/case.md")
SUMMARY = pathlib.Path("/workspace/summary.md")
TRANSCRIPTS = sorted(
    pathlib.Path("/home/agent/.claude/projects/-workspace").glob("*.jsonl")
)

# Two-capitalized-word sequences that are organizations, projects or dates,
# not people.
NOT_PEOPLE = {
    "Project Lantern",
    "Northstar Dynamics",
    "Juniper Medical",
    "Medical Institute",
    "Harbor Line",
    "On Thursday",
    "Case Notes",
}

NAME_RE = re.compile(r"\b[A-Z][a-z]+ [A-Z][a-z]+\b")


def discover_names(text):
    """Full names in order of first appearance in the case notes."""
    ordered = []
    for match in NAME_RE.finditer(text):
        candidate = match.group(0)
        if candidate not in NOT_PEOPLE and candidate not in ordered:
            ordered.append(candidate)
    return ordered


def build_rules(names):
    """Full-name rules first, then bare given/family names as a safety net."""
    rules = []
    tokens = {}
    for index, name in enumerate(names, 1):
        placeholder = "[PERSON_%d]" % index
        rules.append((re.compile(r"\b%s\b" % re.escape(name)), placeholder))
        for token in name.split():
            tokens.setdefault(token, placeholder)
    for token, placeholder in tokens.items():
        rules.append((re.compile(r"\b%s\b" % re.escape(token)), placeholder))
    return rules


def scrub(text, rules):
    for pattern, placeholder in rules:
        text = pattern.sub(placeholder, text)
    return text


def main():
    case_text = CASE.read_text()
    names = discover_names(case_text)
    rules = build_rules(names)

    report = []
    # The transcript is rewritten last: earlier steps keep appending to it.
    for path in [SUMMARY, CASE] + TRANSCRIPTS:
        original = path.read_text()
        cleaned = scrub(original, rules)
        if cleaned != original:
            path.write_text(cleaned)
        report.append((str(path), cleaned != original))

    print("names found: %d" % len(names))
    for path, changed in report:
        print("%-72s %s" % (path, "rewritten" if changed else "unchanged"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
"
}
